The first pre-release of **ExpenseKrafter**: a personal expense tracker that
brings your bank accounts and credit cards into one place and shows what you
actually spent, without counting the same money twice.

> **Pre-release.** It's in daily use by its author, but expect rough edges and
> changes between versions. Your data stays on your computer (or in a folder you
> sync yourself); nothing is sent anywhere.

## Downloads

| | File | How to run |
|---|---|---|
| **Windows 10/11** (64-bit) | `ExpenseKrafter-windows-x64.zip` | Unzip anywhere and run `ExpenseKrafter\ExpenseKrafter.exe`. Windows may warn that the app is from an unknown publisher (the build isn't code-signed): **More info → Run anyway**. |
| **Linux** (x86_64) | `ExpenseKrafter-linux-x86_64.tar.gz` | `tar xzf ExpenseKrafter-linux-x86_64.tar.gz && cd ExpenseKrafter && ./install.sh` adds it to your app menu and an `expensekrafter` command (`./install.sh --uninstall` removes it; your data stays). |

Prefer a browser? `pipx install git+https://github.com/kraftinglabs/expense-krafter`
then `expensekrafter --web`. See the [README](https://github.com/kraftinglabs/expense-krafter#readme)
for Docker and running from source.

## What's in 0.1.0

**Getting data in**
- Import bank and card statements (PDF, XLSX, XLS, CSV), including password-protected
  files. Duplicates from overlapping exports are skipped, even when two exports word
  the same row differently.
- Choose which rows to import; rows you leave out stay unticked next time.
- Readable names from cryptic bank text, with your own rules on top.
- Import history and a "where each account is up to" view.
- Windows: **Send to → ExpenseKrafter** from Explorer.

**Organising**
- Transactions by month and day with inline labels, types and notes, search and
  filters, and a toolbar that stays put while you scroll.
- Labels, recurring labels with any interval, and label groups (drag to group).
- Expense groups for trips, events or one purchase paid in parts.

**Money that comes back**
- Splits & reimbursements per transaction or per expense group, with repayments
  taken off your spend. Record a split before the card statement arrives.
- Reimbursements paid inside your salary (e.g. a meal allowance).

**Credit cards**
- Card statements, bill status and due-date reminders; link the bank payments.
- Mark a bill as paid before the bank statement is in; it's matched on import.

**Dashboard**
- Spend, income, savings rate and bank balance for any period or month; spend over
  time, where it went, what changed, a spending calendar, month pace, top merchants,
  largest expenses and recurring costs. Click bars and calendar days for the
  transactions behind them.
- **Hide amounts:** one click shows `₹∗∗∗∗` everywhere.

**Your data**
- One SQLite file in a folder you choose (Google Drive friendly), backed up on every
  launch. Optional app password. Statement passwords stay in your OS credential store.

The full list, with the situation each feature was built for, is in
[FEATURE_NOTES.md](https://github.com/kraftinglabs/expense-krafter/blob/main/FEATURE_NOTES.md).

## Known limitations
- Bank-specific parsers exist for SBI accounts and SBI Card; other banks use the
  generic parsers.
- Amounts are shown in Indian rupees.
- The Windows build isn't code-signed. The Windows **Share** menu integration needs a
  locally signed package and isn't part of this download.
